accessMatrix.source: Workspace customer knowledge policy / Knowledge Bases / direct source assignments
accessMatrix.finding: Existing active public FAQ, TEXT and WEBSITE sources are included without per-source attachment when useAllEligibleWorkspaceKnowledge is enabled. Explicit Base and direct links remain unioned and source IDs deduplicated. Retrieval checks REGISTERED status, current READY state, active generation, active chunks, visibility and connector/site authorization.
accessMatrix.correction: Resolver now emits accurate accessPaths (DIRECT, KNOWLEDGE_BASE, WORKSPACE_POLICY) and accessPath=MULTIPLE for sources reached through multiple paths; previous output incorrectly labeled all results WORKSPACE_POLICY whenever that policy was enabled.

accessMatrix.source: FAQ, manual text and website pages
accessMatrix.boundary: Effective source resolver -> authorized public source filter -> current-generation chunk retrieval -> evidence/citations
accessMatrix.finding: Public visibility is required for public visitor access. Internal restricted content remains excluded. Current generation/version and active chunk filters are applied; website sources also pass website verification/eligibility checks. Relevant evidence is determined by actual retrieval results, separately from eligible/index-ready source counts.

accessMatrix.source: Shopify products, variants, prices, inventory and collections
accessMatrix.boundary: CommerceReadContracts.productSearchReadiness/searchCatalog -> ConversationOrchestrator search_store_products tool or bounded prefetch -> structured C# evidence
accessMatrix.finding: Registration/execution requires connected tenant-linked integration, fresh verified scope snapshot, provider capability, workspace permission and assistant permission. Field-level permissions control prices, stock and categories/collections; tool evidence carries connection/source ID, sync freshness, source version timestamp, content hash, product locator and bounded variants.

Order scope is classified PROTECTED, requires customer identity and is not assistant-eligible. No public order tool is registered. Customer-specific order access remains unavailable until verified ownership and authorization exist; the Phase 03 change does not weaken this boundary.

accessMatrix.source: Assistant Bot Behavior and business purpose
accessMatrix.boundary: Organization-scoped assistant load -> buildAssistantBehaviorInstruction -> selected provider request
accessMatrix.finding: Assistant-specific configuration is loaded for the selected assistant and tenant and assembled into outbound provider messages. Provider selection/configuration and prompt architecture were not changed.

accessMatrix.boundary: Explicit HELP CONTACTS section -> type-specific validation -> assistant configuration evidence S# -> grounding/citation validation
accessMatrix.finding: Free-form behavior text is not treated as verified fact. Only validated labeled contact values become merchant-configuration evidence.

accessMatrix.boundary: Existing connector adapters and connector knowledge permission filters
accessMatrix.finding: Existing integration-backed knowledge records pass connector category and assistant authorization filters. The public conversation tool registry currently exposes the existing Shopify catalog and public business knowledge search only; no speculative tools were added.

accessMatrix.source: Playground and public widget access policy
accessMatrix.boundary: Shared ConversationOrchestrator -> shared KnowledgeProcessingService public search and CommerceReadContracts authorization
accessMatrix.finding: The existing Playground and widget conversation paths reuse the same orchestrator and public retrieval/tool authorization functions. Widget session/origin validation was not changed.

accessMatrix.boundary: Existing graph storage/execution remains separate; current authorized contracts are reusable services
accessMatrix.finding: No new Agent Builder nodes, execution APIs or second tool engine were implemented. Later reuse requires explicit integration work within its existing runtime scope.

confirmedDefects.cause: When workspace-wide knowledge was enabled, resolver metadata reported WORKSPACE_POLICY for every source, hiding direct and Knowledge Base access paths.
confirmedDefects.fix: Track each source's actual access paths, preserve deduplication, emit MULTIPLE when applicable, and expose accessPaths in the frontend API type.
confirmedDefects.regressionTestUpdated: backend/test/knowledge-base.service.spec.ts: direct/Base deduplication and workspace policy path assertions

securityDispositions: Only the workspace owner may toggle useAllEligibleWorkspaceKnowledge; access checks use resolved membership role.
Public access remains visibility-gated and tenant-scoped; active generation and chunk checks remain required.
Shopify price/inventory/category fields remain separately permission-gated.
Shopify orders are not exposed to customer-facing assistants because current contracts require verified identity and mark the operation assistant-ineligible.
No customer order data, private source or internal instructions were exposed by the change.

testExecution.reason: Explicit Phase 03 instruction prohibits test execution, builds and type checks.
